title: Failure resolution center rebuild
summary: Rebuilt Reports > Failures into a backend-authored Failure Resolution Center with grouped issue triage, one primary next action, guided marker clearing, and an advanced manifest-backed evidence archive flow.
reason: The prior failure table exposed too many row-level buttons, made the next operator action unclear, and used ambiguous Clear error language for marker cleanup.
behavior_before: Reports > Failures was table-first, exposed row-level Open details / Clear error actions, and split marker cleanup across several buttons without a clear guided preview/confirm path.
behavior_after: Reports > Failures shows a summary strip, grouped issue list, selected issue detail, More evidence menu, guided Clear markers preview/confirm flow, and an Advanced evidence archive preview/confirm flow with reason and dry-run fingerprint. Backend failure policy authors resolution_summary and resolution_groups while preserving existing row fields.
tests_added: Added/updated backend failure policy tests for resolution_summary and resolution_groups including mixed owners, retryable rows, marker availability, and empty payloads.
Added/updated command contract and facade tests for /api/failures/archive-evidence strict validation.
Added/updated failure cleanup tests for archive dry-run, reason/fingerprint enforcement, and allowed evidence movement only.

Updated Reports static and browser-backed smoke coverage for grouped failure resolution, More actions, marker clear preview/confirm, archive preview/confirm, duplicate-click guards, and large failure payload containment.
